# FloorInstall

FloorInstall provides professional parquet and vinyl floor installation services in Riga and throughout Latvia.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://floorinstall.lv/)
- [Services](https://floorinstall.lv/services)
- [Gallery](https://floorinstall.lv/gallery)
- [Price estimate](https://floorinstall.lv/price-estimate)
- [Contact](https://floorinstall.lv/contact)

## Services

- Parquet floor installation
- Vinyl floor installation
- French herringbone parquet
- Subfloor preparation
- Floor restoration
- Skirting board installation

For an accurate quote, contact FloorInstall through the contact page and include the room area, floor type, location, and photos if available.
